fields.topic: Pressure level, local wall and nonlinear capacity
fields.finding: The f5 source screens are 1.143285 and 1.083205. The peak-compression local-wall sensitivity is 1.033223 and 0.978132; the 019 sensitivity is below unity. Common-q 1.258252 rows exceed both declared screens.
fields.remaining: A validated local bending/axial interaction, imperfection response and coupled nonlinear capacity are needed. Source 041's verified perfect nonlinear path belongs to its selected f4 section, not these re-sized f5 witnesses.
